title: The Nadia Voss Investigation
description: Nadia's full investigation drops. Six pages. Everything she has found — your father, Vyktor's past, your government's compromises. The country is reading it now.

title: Budget Allocation — Post-Disclosure Framework
description: Nadia's story will dominate the news cycle and shake public confidence. The treasury needs stability regardless. Lock in the fiscal framework while the political class is reading the Dispatch.

title: National Address — Response to Voss
description: Vyktor recommends a national address. Not a press conference — an address. The country needs to hear directly from you, not through Nadia's byline. The broadcast slot is reserved. The cameras will be ready.

title: Military Intelligence — Unusual Signals
description: Danika's intelligence briefing includes a single paragraph that took her three weeks to confirm. Certain officers have been meeting without leaving records. The Iron Covenant's military liaison attended two of the meetings.

title: Dravenni — Military Situation Update
description: The Dravenni front is shifting. Whether they're allies, neutrals, or insurgents depends on choices made in Dravenhollow. Dusek needs updated operational guidance based on the current political reality.

title: Agencies at War
description: Maren Tovik and Viktor Dorne are standing in your office, on opposite sides of the room. The BCA and SSD, both funded at half strength, have turned on each other.
